'''Erland Merich''' was a [[Socorran]] [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] who dealt in [[Trauger gas]]. Taken in by the [[Ibhaan'I]] tribe after he was orphaned, Merich was not much of a [[Scout/Legends|scout]] or a hunter. Looking for ways to support the tribe, Merich began dealing in dangerous Trauger gas. Harvesting the [[Gas/Legends|gas]] led to Merich developing deformities on his hands and face and led to him developing a respiratory disorder. Merich's clientele spanned the galaxy, and he charged between five thousand and one hundred thousand [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] depending on the size of the order. Merich drank to calm his nerves, leading to him becoming a chronic [[Alcohol/Legends|alcoholic]].<ref name="BSS" />
